revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/IBM.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year CAGR computed as (67535000000 / 60530000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from companyfacts, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.basis: Operating margin cannot be computed: companyfacts carries no operating_income_fy series for this issuer at all (coverage lists operating_income among the fields the generic concept mapper did not pick up, 18 of 20 fields found overall), so no operating-income figure exists to divide by revenue.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/IBM.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash from operating activities 13193000000 divided by net income 10593000000 for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/IBM.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 13193000000 less capex 1091000000, divided by revenue 67535000000, fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed: companyfacts carries no operating_income_fy series for this issuer at all, so no EBITDA proxy exists to divide net debt by; see margins.operating_margin basis.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/IBM.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models

ev_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/IBM.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models

implied_fcf_cagr.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/IBM.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 283540378846.12 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 12102000000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth; assumption-dependent, not a reported figure.

horizon_spread.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/IBM.json quality, computed in the Actions venue over SEC EDGAR companyfacts with financetoolkit.models
horizon_spread.basis: Spread between the implied CAGR solved over the shortest and longest explicit periods in quality.reverse_dcf.implied_by_horizon; inherits the same assumed discount rate and terminal growth.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off fetched fundamentals as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from fetched fundamentals/quality, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for in the fetched market file and not found, or not computable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
